posts.cooked: I minted it, but it was a very challenging fight. It's very hard to keep Equipment or Ongoing cards in play with Ermine, especially with the cards she plays. The key lies in taking out the villain characters in a good order (i.e., take out Ermine first), and utilizing the environment wisely. Time Cataclysm's first play is Crushing Hallway, but considering Ongoings are hard to keep in play anyway, it might be wise to keep it in play just for the sake of hitting all villain targets for 4 melee damage each. Heroes will also be hit by it... unless you could somehow, I dunno, get all hero targets not named Legacy immune to damage somehow... maybe... ;-)

posts.cooked: Mint.  Got to use Heroic Interception twice, thanks to Calypso.  Kept Crushing Hallway out.  Mostly went straight for the villains and ignored the rest.  Ermine died first, then Fright Train, then Proletariot, and then Baron Blade and Friction went down together when we hit Fixed Point.  Fixed Point didn't actually do much - it kept AZ alive to get some extra hits in, but I would have won anyways, and Friction wasn't dead by the time I reached her turn.  Nearly screwed up in that Crushing Hallway went off before Fixed Point died, but a) I still had Tachyon at 1 hp even though everyone else was below, and b) I got to choose the order in which things were destroyed, so it didn't matter anways.   I finished with all my heroes except Legacy alive, but only Tachyon above 0 hp.

posts.cooked:
Fun fight, and yeah, Crushing Hallway definitely hurt the villains waaaay more than it hurt me. Mint, with everyone still standing (and with positive hp), with Wraith even finishing in double-digits (well... 12, but still! Took down Ermine hard and fast as once she's down, you can actually start building up. Fright Train was next, followed by Proletariat, Blade and finally Friction, though she got to stick around until the start of the environment turn, due to Fixed Point.

 

Heroic Interception, some well-placed throat punches and careful micro-management of who gets hit (to avoid Nemesis bonus) can really save you from a LOT of pain in this one.

posts.name: Reverend Pete
posts.cooked:
Mint.

 

Everybody at 5HP or under at the end.  Felt lucky to have Fixed Point come out on the turn that Legacy played Take Down. That was VERY helpful.

 

All heroes had their shining moments, but I felt like Wraith was my MVP. Smoke bombs kept Legacy from incapacitation, Razor Ordinance with MicroTargeting Computer dealt the most damage of any other power by far (it's the power I used to activate with Legacy most often, too), and Throat Jabs and Grappling Hooks were essential, I found. A co-MVP was Legacy with Take Downs and Heroic Interceptions.

Ermine first (took longer than I wanted), Fright Train 2nd, Friction 3rd (wanted it to be Proletariat, but he kept hanging on!), 4th Proletariat (took a long time), and Blade was last. Blade, because of Negation Bands, was almost at full HP by the time I got to him, and it looked grim, because all heroes were in low single digits, but with no other help, Blade went down pretty quickly (a couple of well-placed Razor Ordinances went a long way).

 

Legacy at 1HP, Bunker 4HP, Tachyon 3HP, Absolute Zero 5HP and Wraith 5HP.

posts.name: bolnerap
posts.cooked:
Melkhor:
Just curious, but why would you ever want to prioritise taking out Constant Prattle over Baron Blade's Enhanced Physique?

That's what I do in almost every Vengeance match I play. Constant Prattle synergizes  too well with Friction, and I really hate how it works with Heavy Hitter. By contrast, Heavy Hitter can be mitigated more easily once Constant Prattle is gone and you know what's on top of a hero's deck (that hero has a draw 1 play 1, you have a way to play the top card of a hero deck, etc).

I leave Constant Prattle out situationally, if I have a way of trash-searching like Vernal Sonata or Reclaim From the Deep at the start of the game, or if I happen to have a match with Tachyon but without Friction. Otherwise, it gets trashed ASAP, before Enhanced Physique (usually my second Ongoing target).

Mint. I blew up Constant Prattle in round 1 and was rewarded in round 2 with some sweet, sweet Fueled Freeze action. Damage MVP Wraith had a triple Impromptu Invention that set her up for good just after Ermine went down. Burned an LSB early (7 damage) to make sure that happened. My kill order was Ermine / Fright Train (same round), Proletariat / Blade (same round), then finished off Friction. All heroes survived with 2-3 HP.

Oh, and like others, I left Crushing Hallway out, it helped as much as or more than it hurt.
